validation.note: Board-role stochastic roster reconstruction. Each projected skater draws appearance, games conditional on appearing, and top/middle/depth deployment from the cutoff-safe fantasy board; established RAPM prices the sampled role but cannot assign the role. Every club receives exactly 300 skater-minutes per scheduled team-game, split between forwards and defence from the league forecast pool, so extra reserve players cannot manufacture extra ice. Each historical season uses its forecast-known schedule length. Against the same v6 roster-value baseline over 2,460 held-out games and 62 held-out team-seasons, the selected mixture improved game log loss from 0.686242 to 0.683624, game Brier from 0.246642 to 0.245405, points RMSE from 13.370753 to 12.878735, contender-weighted RMSE from 12.109436 to 11.319139, and points CRPS from 7.497120 to 7.227878. Qualification uses a separate head: adding goalie uncertainty and a learned residual scale for prior missed-player value improved Brier from 0.222881 to 0.201399 and AUC from 0.706250 to 0.768750; Brier improved in both held-out folds. Neither extension was promoted for games or points. Player-age, age-adjusted roster-change, their three-way combination, deterministic mean availability, portable-neutral roster value, and aggregate schedule-distribution candidates were rejected after losing the relevant held-out proper-score comparisons. The focused mixture sample is smaller than v6 because cutoff-safe fantasy role probabilities exist for four training seasons, so this is evidence of an improvement on the available held-out sample, not a claim of universal superiority.

recent_basis: Recent mover lists use custom rating changes versus the 2026-03-27 snapshot, which is the day before the weighted-median 10th most recent team game. Skater movers use overall talent score, team movers use total team score, goalie movers use goalie score, and usage lists compare the most recent 10 games to the previous 10.
